mapper.select: SELECT A.guardian_id, A.guardian_name, A.user_id AS protected_user_id, A.relation, A.status AS connection_status FROM tb_guardian A WHERE A.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT G.user_id AS protected_user_id, U.user_name AS protected_user_name, G.relation, CASE G.relation WHEN 'FAMILY' THEN '가족' WHEN 'ACQUAINTANCE' THEN '지인' ELSE G.relation END AS relation_name, G.status AS connection_status, CASE G.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '승인 대기' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '연결됨' ELSE G.status END AS connection_status_name FROM tb_guardian G INNER JOIN tb_user U ON U.user_id = G.user_id AND U.user_type = 'PROTECTED' WHERE G.guardian_id = #{guardianId} ORDER BY G.guardian_seq
mapper.insert:
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(guardian_seq AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 AS CHAR) AS guardian_seq FROM tb_guardian
INSERT INTO tb_guardian ( user_id, guardian_seq, guardian_id, guardian_name, relation, status, reg_user_id, reg_date, last_chg_user_id, last_chg_date ) VALUES ( #{protectedUserId}, #{guardianSeq}, #{guardianId}, #{guardianName}, #{relation}, 'PENDING', #{guardianId}, NOW(), #{guardianId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_guardian SET status = 'APPROVED', last_chg_user_id = #{protectedUserId}, last_chg_date = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{protectedUserId} AND guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND status = 'PENDING'
